extended_technical_topics.description: Topic-only bucket (no question text), same shape as language fundamentals. Role-bound, not language-bound. sampling_weight = frequency_score x recency_multiplier.

topics.topic: JWT — structure and stateless auth flow
JWT security considerations (expiry, refresh tokens, revocation)
Authentication vs Authorization (and RBAC vs ABAC)
REST API design principles and versioning
CORS — what it is and why it exists
CSRF and how to prevent it in a stateless API
Password storage (hashing, salting, bcrypt vs plain hashing)
Message queues and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
Git branching strategies and collaboration workflow

system_design_scenarios.description: Scenario/seed-prompt based, NOT question-text based. Tagged by difficulty — sample within the candidate's chosen difficulty_level. One scenario per interview (k=1). sampling_weight = frequency_score x recency_multiplier.

scenarios.name: URL Shortener
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a URL shortening service like Bitly.

scenarios.name: Rate Limiter
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a rate limiter for a public API.

scenarios.name: Parking Lot System
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a parking lot management system.

scenarios.name: Pastebin / Text Sharing Service
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a pastebin-like text sharing service.

scenarios.name: Notification Service
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a notification system that supports email, SMS, and push notifications.

scenarios.name: Social Media Feed
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design the backend for a social media feed like Twitter or Instagram.

scenarios.name: Chat Application
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a real-time chat service like WhatsApp or Slack.

scenarios.name: E-commerce Order System
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design the backend for an e-commerce order and checkout system.

scenarios.name: Job Scheduler
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a job scheduler that runs tasks at specific times or intervals.

scenarios.name: File Sharing / Storage Service
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a file storage and sharing service like Google Drive or Dropbox.

scenarios.name: Ride-Sharing Backend
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design the backend for a ride-sharing service like Uber, including driver matching.

scenarios.name: Video Streaming Platform
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a video streaming platform like YouTube.

scenarios.name: Distributed Job Queue with Retries
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a distributed job queue that handles retries, priorities, and failure recovery across multiple worker nodes.

scenarios.name: News Feed Ranking / Recommendation System
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a content recommendation system for a news feed, considering ranking and personalization.

scenarios.name: Web Crawler
scenarios.seed_prompt: Design a web crawler that can scale to billions of pages.

scenarios.topic: SQL Injection Mechanics in DBAPI (%s placeholders vs f-strings)
scenarios.why_it_matters: Tests real security application over textbook definition. Verifies that the candidate uses database parameter escaping properly rather than insecure string formatting.
Highly relevant for modern Python backend engineering. Evaluates deep understanding of query planning, binary protocol optimization, and the evolution of modern drivers.
